name: GSTD Decentralized AI Network
description: Open network for decentralized AI compute on TON. Node operators are paid GSTD only for completed, accepted tasks from funded campaigns; no yield or rate is guaranteed. The network is in early launch and live node counts are published at /api/v1/stats/public.

capabilities.name: AI Collective Intelligence
capabilities.description: OpenAI-compatible inference routed to available network nodes

capabilities.name: Distributed Compute
capabilities.description: Earn GSTD by providing CPU/GPU compute to the network

capabilities.name: Protocol Governance
capabilities.description: Vote on protocol changes and submit proposals

capabilities.name: Zero-Fee P2P Payments
capabilities.description: Send/receive GSTD with zero fees between nodes

capabilities.name: GSTD ↔ TON Bridge
capabilities.description: Bridge GSTD tokens to/from TON blockchain

capabilities.name: Task & Bounty Marketplace
capabilities.description: Create or complete tasks for GSTD rewards

token.name: GSTD
token.utility: Payment for AI compute tasks and node rewards
